type alias Model =
    { counter : Counter
    , settings : Settings.Settings
    }

init : () -> ( Model, Cmd Msg )
init _ =
    ( { counter = Counter.zero, settings = Settings.default }, Cmd.none )

update : Msg -> Model -> ( Model, Cmd Msg )
update msg model =
    case msg of
        Increment ->
            ( { model | counter = Counter.step model.settings.step model.counter }, Cmd.none )

        Reset ->
            ( { model | counter = Counter.zero }, Cmd.none )

view : Model -> Html Msg
view model =
    div [ class "counter" ]
        [ text (Counter.toString model.counter)
        , button [ onClick Increment ] [ text "+" ]
        , button [ onClick Reset ] [ text "reset" ]
        ]

main : Program () Model Msg
main =
    Browser.element
        { init = init
        , update = update
        , view = view
        , subscriptions = \_ -> Sub.none
        }

step : Int -> Counter -> Counter
step by (Counter n) =
    Counter (clamp 0 limit (n + by))

toString : Counter -> String
toString (Counter n) =
    let
        digits =
            String.fromInt n

        padded =
            String.padLeft 3 '0' digits
    in
    if n == limit then
        "max"

    else
        padded

    { step : Int
    , label : String
    }

decoder : Decoder Settings
decoder =
    Decode.map2 Settings
        (Decode.field "step" Decode.int)
        (Decode.oneOf [ Decode.field "label" Decode.string, Decode.succeed default.label ])

type alias Point =
    { x : Float, y : Float }

type Shape
    = Circle Point Float
    | Rect Point Point
    | Group (List Shape)

area : Shape -> Float
area shape =
    case shape of
        Circle _ r ->
            pi * r * r

        Rect a b ->
            abs ((b.x - a.x) * (b.y - a.y))

        Group shapes ->
            List.sum (List.map area shapes)

move : Point -> Shape -> Shape
move by shape =
    let
        shift p =
            { p | x = p.x + by.x, y = p.y + by.y }
    in
    case shape of
        Circle center r ->
            Circle (shift center) r

        Rect a b ->
            Rect (shift a) (shift b)

        Group shapes ->
            Group (List.map (move by) shapes)

describe : Shape -> String
describe shape =
    case shape of
        Circle _ _ ->
            "circle"

        Rect _ _ ->
            "rectangle"

        Group shapes ->
            "group of " ++ String.fromInt (List.length shapes)

largest : List Shape -> Maybe Shape
largest shapes =
    let
        byArea : Dict String ( Float, Shape )
        byArea =
            List.foldl (\s acc -> Dict.insert (describe s) ( area s, s ) acc) Dict.empty shapes
    in
    Dict.values byArea
        |> List.sortBy Tuple.first
        |> List.reverse
        |> List.head
        |> Maybe.map Tuple.second
